exact_identity: brier_binned = reliability - resolution + uncertainty, exact to 1e-9; brier (unbinned) differs from brier_binned only by the within-bin spread of the forecasts, which is reported as brier_shift_from_binning
interval_note: for the interval on this skill score see backtest_summary.csv; it is not reprinted here
note: reliability is the part of the score the model could remove by being better calibrated; resolution is the part it earns by saying different things on different games. Bins are fixed probability ranges, not exact values: an exact-value split puts one game in each bin and makes reliability equal the Brier score, which measures nothing. If bins_used equals n, the panel is degenerate and must not be quoted. The bootstrap resamples whole weeks.
